shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure shown frontally/in profile as the sole subject
upper body with indications of garment or ornament
incised circular/disc motifs on the body (rosette-like disc on A's wrist and belt ornaments; roundels on B's chest)
carved band across the torso/waist suggesting a belt or sash
justification: Both depict a single humanoid figure occupying the whole field, with some incised discs and a band across the torso, but these are near-universal traits of figural monuments. A shows a detailed profile winged figure with raised hand, elaborate beard, patterned garment and held objects, rendered in fine naturalistic low relief, while B is a massive blocky schematic head-and-shoulders with minimal features, no wings, no arms in action and no held attributes — the depictive conventions have nothing in common.
